'''Bay of Conquest''', formerly known as the '''Ja-Phelar Bay''', was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] located between the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phelar/Legends|Phelar]] and the [[Ja highlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[Phelar Floe]] [[Water/Legends|river]] flows into the Bay of Conquest from the south.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> Known as the Ja-Phelar Bay during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], it was renamed after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
